payload.author: claude
payload.body: CORRECTION (board audit): this shipped the LiveKit token-minting SfuBackend (offline HS256 JWT) ONLY. The server-side SFU MEDIA NEGOTIATION (SfuConnectTransport/SfuProduce/SfuConsume) remains STUBBED in the gateway (Nack mediaUnsupported) — i.e. self-hosted mediasoup-style produce/consume is NOT implemented. That gap is tracked in FR-292. LiveKit is wired into boot via FRICK_CALLS_MEDIA_PLANE=livekit; the LiveKit client model does not use those ops (clients connect to LiveKit directly).
